text:
aj: heads up — seeing +15% p99 token latency on dedicated slices in us-west1 (rack-12). spike aligns with a tenant burst pattern. suspect NIC saturation + KV-cache churn from one noisy tenant. anyone oncall who can help triage?

marta: on it. can you paste the prometheus snippet? also which slice id?

aj: slice=dedicated-usw1-s12. metrics snippet:
```
gpu_util{rack="rack-12"}=0.82
nic_tx_mbps{host="rack-12-host3"}=1450
kv_cache_miss_rate{tenant="mlprep"}=0.27
request_latency_p99{slice="dedicated-usw1-s12"}=184ms
```

elaine: sounds like egress + kv churn. quick mitigation: priority-proxy-stitch to reroute low-priority tenants through the alternate NIC path and apply soft cordon on the hot host. cost: extra egress hops but saves p99 SLA violations.

tim: +1 for soft cordon. if we do proxy-stitching we should also disable prefetch for the offending tenant to reduce KV regen. prefetch=false per-tenant is cheap.

sre-oncall: starting immediate actions: 1) applied egress shaper (20% throttle) on rack-12-host3, 2) evicting batch jobs labeled `best-effort` from nodes in the slice, 3) scheduling a quick warmup for dedicated warm pool in adjacent rack.

ops-bot: cordon request accepted — node rack-12-host3 cordoned by @sre-oncall at 2024-09-11T14:02:12Z :white_check_mark:

marta: after the shaper p99 dropped to 98ms (preliminary). can we push a fingerprint rule so this tenant gets pro-active soft-isolation next time?

elaine: long-term proposal: tenant fingerprinting based on two signals — sustained kv_miss_rate >0.15 and nic_tx_mbps tail >1Gbps over a 5m window. policy would: 1) route future allocs to fractional dedicated slices, 2) enable per-tenant prefetch=false, 3) mark for billing review (cost recapture). draft routing rule snippet: 
```
route_adjustment: {
  condition: (kv_miss_rate > 0.15 && nic_tx_mbps > 1000),
  actions: ["fractional_dedicate", "disable_prefetch", "escalate_billing"]
}
```

aj: that policy looks solid. downside is increased reserved capacity cost if many tenants get flagged. want to simulate first on a 24h window for top 5 noisy tenants.

sre-oncall: agree — run sim + then canary deploy the routing rule in us-west1 (10% of allocs). i'll own rollout.

marta: i'll open a quick cost model doc for the 24h sim and tag finance for a sanity check.

elaine: nice work team. follow-ups: (1) marta run sim, (2) tim add prefetch toggle to tenant API, (3) aj monitor slice latency for 2h and report. cc @product for SLA notes. :thumbsup:
